emails.subject: Northwind Payments and the new partner API
emails.body:
Hi Maya,

We help growing fintech teams keep customer data safe while they scale, without hiring a full security operations team first. Our analysts watch the alerts, handle the noisy ones and only wake your engineers for the issues that matter.

Would a 20-minute call next week be useful to see whether this fits how Northwind Payments works today?

Best regards,
Sam
Partnerships team, Example Security
